title: Apply Flying 2.0 Version 4 Production Evidence Delta
rationale: Version 4 tightens proof standards for real production Unreal content, authorized reproducible content-builds, production pilot regional data, current signed Shipping runtime visual evidence, ECEF-driven aircraft visual authority and complete evidence-ledger synchronization without removing or weakening any mandatory requirement.
supersededReleaseCriteria: Treating manifest presence or missing external content as sufficient proof of production Unreal content
Treating fixture-generated regional packages as production Ceska Trebova coverage evidence
Treating non-Shipping, stale, headless or synthetic visual captures as production visual acceptance evidence
Treating presentation-owned aircraft transforms as proof of authoritative CoreSim visual positioning
replacementReleaseCriteria: Production Unreal content must be represented by versioned usable assets or an authorized reproducible content-build from audited sources
Production pilot regional package evidence must come from licensed source payloads and generated package manifests with provenance, checksums, attribution and offline runtime compatibility
Runtime visual evidence must be captured from the current signed Win64 Unreal Shipping build and must record commit SHA, build id, graphics profile, scenario id, artifact path and performance metrics
Aircraft visual proof must demonstrate rendered transforms driven by CoreSim authoritative WGS-84 ECEF snapshots
The evidence ledger must contain exactly one current proof-backed or blocker-backed entry for every active immutable Flying 2.0 requirement

migrationImpactNotes.impact: Production content manifests must distinguish usable packaged Unreal assets from authorized reproducible content-build outputs and carry schemaVersion, createdAt, sourceRefs, checksums, licenseRefs, attribution and bounds. Manifest-only records, fixture-generated packages and missing external files remain invalid production proof.

Production visual evidence records must include commit SHA, build id, signed Win64 Unreal Shipping configuration, graphics profile, scenario id, artifact path, performance metrics, manual approval state and the mandatory scene checklist. Evidence from non-Shipping builds, stale commits or synthetic/headless captures blocks release.

Ledger synchronization is required for all active immutable requirements by semantic requirement id. New v4 requirements must be represented by proofRefs or external blockerRefs before milestone or release gate completion is considered.

milestones.name: Contract, Legal And Data Gates
milestones.exitGate: legal, data provenance and aircraft data blockers are recorded before production claims

milestones.name: Core Simulation And Vertical Slice
milestones.exitGate: headless simulation, initial terrain, airport, replay and telemetry evidence is recorded

milestones.name: Production Content And Systems
milestones.exitGate: production aircraft, configured regional package evidence, regional airport coverage, weather and cockpit evidence is recorded

milestones.name: Packaging, Licensing And Quality Gates
milestones.exitGate: performance, stability, installer, signing, SBOM, visual quality and license evidence is recorded

milestones.name: Release Candidate Acceptance
milestones.exitGate: release candidate is blocked unless every mandatory clean-machine, automated, coverage, validation, performance and soak result passes

requirements.title: Immutable Contract Governance
requirements.summary: Maintain a versioned contract, milestone gates, approved change process, prohibited substitutes and explicit blockers for mandatory obligations.
requirements.evidenceGate: must have linked proof or blocker before milestone completion

requirements.title: Requirement Evidence Traceability
requirements.summary: Every requirement links to concrete proof or an external blocker, and failed mandatory evidence blocks release.
requirements.evidenceGate: must have linked proof or blocker before milestone completion

requirements.title: Final Release Gates
requirements.summary: Release completes only when performance, physics, regional terrain packages, regional airport coverage, legal/license, production visual quality, stability, installer, replay, telemetry, privacy and end-to-end workflow gates pass for the pilot release package.
requirements.evidenceGate: must have linked proof and passing mandatory gate results for release

requirements.title: Authoritative Documentation Alignment
requirements.summary: Current authoritative Flying 2.0 documentation records regional GIS scope and treats AGENTS.md as non-authoritative task context.
requirements.evidenceGate: must have updated documentation proving the active regional contract before dependent implementation work

requirements.title: Regional GIS Pipeline
requirements.summary: GIS source discovery, normalization and generated runtime packages are selected by region and configured margins, not by complete Czech Republic download or local storage by default.
requirements.evidenceGate: must have region configuration, source-selection evidence and package manifests before production terrain claims

requirements.title: Regional DMR Terrain Coverage
requirements.summary: Provide offline DMR 5G-based terrain coverage for each installed configured region, including the first 10 x 10 km Ceska Trebova pilot region, with LOD, water/material masks, normals, collision tiles, metadata and seam validation.
requirements.evidenceGate: must have region package terrain manifests and validation reports before production terrain claims

requirements.title: Configurable Offline Regional Packages
requirements.summary: Geographic content is distributed as independently installable offline regional packages described by versioned region configurations; the first release includes the Ceska Trebova 10 x 10 km pilot package without hard-coded Czech-only or Ceska Trebova-specific application logic.
requirements.evidenceGate: must have explicit region manifests, package manifests and runtime compatibility checks before release

requirements.title: Ceska Trebova Pilot Region
requirements.summary: The first milestone for the regional GIS pipeline is a complete end-to-end 10 x 10 km Ceska Trebova pilot package; the pilot is configuration data, not architecture logic.
requirements.evidenceGate: must have pilot region package evidence before broader regional rollout claims
